## How to Test

1. `npm install`
2. Press `F5` to launch the Extension Development Host
3. Open a `.env` file
4. Run `Cloak: Hide Secrets` from the command palette
5. Verify the expected behavior

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Extension packages successfully (`npm run package`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (if user-facing change)
- [ ] `README.md` updated (if commands or settings changed)
- [ ] `package.json` `contributes` updated (if new commands/settings/menus)
- [ ] `Commands`/`Settings` enums updated (if new commands/settings)
